title: Token aggregator: adaptive prefill hinting and decode coordinator to lower per-request overhead
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: We see a significant fraction of CPU and scheduling overhead on the prefill path for short prompts and high-velocity small requests. Existing tokenization hotpaths help but don't coordinate well with the decode scheduler and kernel selection layer, leading to extra allocations and duplicative work when multiple requests share prefixes or arrive in quick succession. Goal: implement a lightweight token aggregator + decode coordinator that emits adaptive prefill hints to the kernel selection layer and the decode scheduler so we can (1) coalesce prefix work, (2) avoid redundant UTF8 normalization passes, and (3) choose kernels tuned to observed sequence-length distribution without violating latency SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: Aggregate and reuse prefix tokenization for requests that arrive within a 6ms window and share a 90% prefix hash — validated in synthetic microbenchmarks.
Reduce median prefill CPU time for 8-64 token requests by >=25% on p3-standard profiling workloads.
No increase in 99th percentile end-to-end latency beyond 2% for target latency SLO routes during a canary run.
Provide metrics in Console: per-route prefix-hit-rate, token-aggregation-rate, and kernel-hint-adoption.
Feature gated and disabled by default per customer; can be toggled by route-level config and rollout policies.
technical_notes: Introduce TokenAggregator component on the prefill lane: lightweight ringbuffer keyed by session+prefix-hash, TTL 50ms, configurable slot count.
Emit KernelHint objects (sequence_length_bucket, beam_shape_hint, quantized_compatibility) to runtime via existing kernel-selection API.
DecodeCoordinator will subscribe to aggregation events and schedule decode microbatches prioritizing aggregated groups when latency headroom is available.
UTF8 normalization and unicode-normalization will be memoized at the aggregator layer keyed by normalized string fingerprint; memo limited to 1K entries per worker to bound memory.
Use adaptive heuristics: if aggregation increases 99p latency on canary, automatically reduce aggregation window by halves until safe.
Instrumentation: add lightweight eBPF timer in development builds for micro-latency profiling of prefill vs decode transition.
implementation_steps: Design: finalize TokenAggregator API and kernel hint schema (document linked in Confluence).
Prototype: in dev runtime, implement aggregator ringbuffer and a mock KernelHint sink; measure microbenchmarks.
Integration: hook KernelHint into kernel selection codepath and propagate decode scheduling hints to the decode worker pool.
Safety: add canary flag, route-level config, and automatic throttle when latency regressions observed.
Testing: unit tests for aggregator eviction, correctness tests for prefix reuse, e2e perf tests with traffic replay of real logs.
Canary: rollout to internal tenant + 5 customers for 48h with aggressive monitoring alerts on 99p latency and error rates.
Ship: flip default to enabled for internal tier after validation; provide docs in Console and changelog.
